emily_cs: FYI escalated from ACME Support — after our recent small quantization change (int8->int4 micro-tweak) their contract-summary endpoint started inventing regulatory clauses that aren't in source docs.
raj_support: can you paste request id + example outputs?
emily_cs: request_id=rc-20260315-ACME-9932, model=redwood-2.2.1-q4, prev_model=redwood-2.2.0, prompt: `summarize_contract(client_docs)`
emily_cs: example output (customer): \"According to RegA-7, Acme must provide annual attestations to RegA oversight board\" — no such clause in input.
marta_research: whoa. any diffs in temperature/top_p or prompt templates?
emily_cs: no template changes. latency improved ~18ms avg, hallucination flags jumped in their telemetry (0.9% -> 6.2%) after deploy.
tim_oncall: tagging infra logs and model logs. can we repro locally with pinned seed?
raj_support: repro steps from customer: POST /v1/generate with body {model: 'redwood-2.2.1-q4', input: <doc id 879>, temperature: 0.0, max_tokens: 256}
raj_support: paste of exact response attached by customer (inline): ```Summary: ...RegA-7... annual attestations...```
chris_prod: deploybot shows a small quantization flag flip at 2026-03-15T03:10Z to `enable_int4_micro` on canary then rolled at 03:25Z
deploybot: Deploy notice: rollout redwood-2.2.1-q4 toggle enable_int4_micro rolled to 60% at 2026-03-15T03:25Z
marta_research: possible causes: quantization-induced embedding drift or altered tokenization alignment. Need embedding cosine checks + few-shot prompt sensitivity tests.
emily_cs: customer asked for immediate mitigation — they want roll back to previous variant.
tim_oncall: mitigation options: 1) route ACME to redwood-2.2.0 until fix 2) pin their workspace to previous model 3) set quality gating to strict (disable q4 path) for their account.
raj_support: I've provisionally routed them to redwood-2.2.0-downgrade and submitted escalation ticket #CS-7892. Notified account exec.
marta_research: I'll run a small batch of benchmarks on 200 contract examples comparing outputs and embedding distances. will report in 2 hours.
emily_cs: thanks. customer is available for live debugging 16:00 PST.
raj_support: adding logs: correlation id rc-20260315-ACME-9932, cfg snippet: `{"quantize":"q4_0","kv_cache":true}`
chris_prod: will also run a canary with quantization disabled on 10% to compare.
emily_cs: customer wants confirmation when rolled back or when routed. :pray: 
raj_support: will update thread with remediation + ETA.
